recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not make Flag.code optional or reintroduce separate note/code elements for FHIR-3523 unless a new applied/published tracker changes the Flag model.
issue_request: FHIR-3523 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care request to make Alert.note optional and add an Alert.code CodeableConcept, but its final resolution retained cardinality and changed the element type to CodeableConcept so text-only or coded alerts could both be represented.
initial_application: Commit 2c92ad758b99c339d1874693c435b421496a8ea2 explicitly applied #3523 by changing Alert.note from string to CodeableConcept and updating the example while preserving 1..1 cardinality. Commit db4ace37c6615c9732f958d34d6286fe739fc657 later renamed Alert to Flag and carried the required CodeableConcept forward as Flag.code.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini makes Flag the active resource, lists Alert as removed, and records that Alert became Flag. Related Published issues FHIR-3292 and FHIR-3877 explain the same Alert.note code/cardinality family; FHIR-3877 was already represented on the combined branch. Later FHIR-8560 and FHIR-11202 reinforce the current Flag.code value-set binding and coded/textual short wording. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml defines Flag.code as 1..1 CodeableConcept with CodeableConcept.text guidance for non-coded values, and current source searches found no stale Alert.note or Flag.note element.
